sentences.text: Boluochia is an enantiornithean bird belonging to the family Longipterygidae.
Although originally described with a hooked beak, further research suggests Boluochia had a normal, toothed, and elongated snout.
The fourth metatarsal diverges significantly in Boluochia, separating the outer toe when perched, a feature present on both feet and not seen in juvenile Longipteryx.
The genus Boluochia was first described by Zhou in 1995, and the species Boluochia zhengi was described by Zhang et al. in 2001.
Fossils of Boluochia are known from the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, China.
Boluochia lived during the Early Cretaceous, specifically between 121.6 and 110.6 million years ago, while Boluochia zhengi lived approximately 120 million years ago in the Aptian.
The Paleobiology Database records the time range for Boluochia as 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
